int_name: N BROAD ST & W OLNEY AVE

result.summary: The image shows a wide commercial corridor with a marked zebra crosswalk and a concrete median refuge. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and a median are present, the high volume of traffic, wide crossing distance, and lack of signalized control at this specific crossing point create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: High Crossing Exposure
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without the protection of a traffic signal or stop sign.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, across the zebra markings

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Multi-lane Crossing
hazards.description: The presence of a bus and multiple cars suggests high traffic volume and speed on a road with four or more lanes, increasing the risk of multiple-threat crashes.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon (PHB)
interventions.description: Install a signalized crossing to provide a protected interval for pedestrians to cross this wide arterial.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Signage and RRFBs
interventions.description: Add Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons and 'Yield to Pedestrian' signage to increase driver compliance at the crosswalk.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane urban intersection with marked crosswalks and traffic signals. hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracking and uneven asphalt in the roadway near the crossing area could present tripping hazards or affect vehicle braking.
